literal_meaning: লাট (স্পিনিং টপ) খাওয়া (পতন বা ধসে পড়া)
figurative_meaning_en: To fall headlong or tumble down, to be on the brink of collapse
example_sentences_in_english: The country's economy is tumbling down.
His business has gone head over heels into failure.
note: Originates from the image of a spinning top (লাট) losing momentum and falling flat, a common childhood plaything in Bengali culture.
